title: Lung Cancer Production Identity Manifest v1
description: A disease-specific Oncology manifest. Resolves the existing canonical 'Lung Cancer' disease created by the Oncology Foundation (PR #45) and adds ONLY source-supported identity knowledge from the NCI cancer-types catalog: five new Tier 4 PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE variants, nine Tier 5 identity concepts, and eight explicit, individually-declared applicability mappings. Does not create a universal cancer manifest, does not copy this content to another cancer disease, does not mix the Pulmonary Disease LCD manifest with Lung Cancer identity knowledge, and does not create stage, grade, laterality, molecular-subtype, metastatic-destination, symptom, diagnostic, treatment, medication, or prognosis knowledge -- none of that is supported by the approved source for this PR.

required_existing_disease.note: Must already exist from the Oncology Foundation import (PR #45). This importer resolves it by exact name and rejects creating a duplicate; it never creates a new Lung Cancer disease row.

new_variants.name: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
new_variants.evidence_requirement: Requires patient-record pathology evidence before this PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE variant is ever treated as a confirmed patient-specific fact. Diagnosis alone never establishes this variant, stage, grade, molecular subtype, or hospice eligibility.

new_variants.name: Small Cell Lung Cancer
new_variants.evidence_requirement: Requires patient-record pathology evidence before this PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE variant is ever treated as a confirmed patient-specific fact. Never collapsed with Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer. Never inherits limited-stage or extensive-stage distinctions, which this PR does not create.

new_variants.name: Pleuropulmonary Blastoma
new_variants.evidence_requirement: Requires patient-record pathology evidence before this PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE variant is ever treated as a confirmed patient-specific fact. Never collapsed with Non-Small Cell or Small Cell Lung Cancer.

new_variants.name: Tracheobronchial Tumor
new_variants.evidence_requirement: Requires patient-record pathology evidence before this PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE variant is ever treated as a confirmed patient-specific fact. Never automatically equivalent to Bronchial Tumor.

new_variants.name: Bronchial Tumor
new_variants.evidence_requirement: Requires patient-record pathology evidence before this PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE variant is ever treated as a confirmed patient-specific fact. Never automatically equivalent to Tracheobronchial Tumor.

unsupported_variants_not_created.note: The approved source (Cancer-Types-NCI-08.22.2021.pdf) does not define these for Lung Cancer in this PR. None of the following are created:
unsupported_variants_not_created.STAGE: not defined by the current source for this PR (no Stage I/II/III/IV Lung Cancer)
unsupported_variants_not_created.GRADE: not defined by the current source for this PR
unsupported_variants_not_created.LATERALITY: not defined by the current source (no left/right/bilateral distinction)
unsupported_variants_not_created.HISTOLOGY: not defined by the current source for this PR beyond the five approved PATHOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE variants (no adenocarcinoma, squamous-cell carcinoma, large-cell carcinoma, or neuroendocrine subtype)
unsupported_variants_not_created.MOLECULAR_SUBTYPE: not defined by the current source for this PR (no molecular-driver subtype)
unsupported_variants_not_created.METASTATIC_DESTINATION: not defined by the current source for this PR (no bone, brain, liver, adrenal, or pleural metastasis destinations)
unsupported_variants_not_created.SMALL_CELL_STAGE_SPLIT: no approved dimension for limited-stage/extensive-stage Small Cell Lung Cancer exists in this PR

concepts.description: Lung Cancer identity concept from the NCI cancer-types catalog. Authorizes cancer-identity knowledge only; never auto-confirms diagnosis, stage, grade, molecular subtype, treatment, prognosis, or hospice eligibility. Distinct from Lung Primary Site (a Tier 4 variant of any solid malignancy that metastasizes to the lung) and from Lung Metastasis From Another Primary Cancer.

unattached_concepts_not_given_applicabil.note: Lung Cancer (base identity) is intentionally given ZERO applicability edges in this PR. It anchors the disease's own identity, not a Tier 4 variant, and the approved source declares each pathological subtype and foundation state as its own distinct applicability mapping instead.

guard_note: A 'Diagnosis DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH Prognosis' guard was intentionally omitted. The Oncology Foundation import (PR #45) reuses two shared PROGNOSTIC_INDICATOR concepts (Progressive Disease, Worsening Clinical Status) across every cancer disease, including Lung Cancer, so a no_concept_in_domain(PROGNOSTIC_INDICATOR) assertion would always fail for a reason unrelated to this manifest. This manifest attaches zero new PROGNOSTIC_INDICATOR concepts or applicability edges of its own (see unattached_concepts_not_given_applicability / applicability list above), which is verified instead by the concepts/applicability count guards.
